## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The retry cap must be corrected before merge because the helper exceeds the project’s required five-attempt limit.

## Changes
The pull request adds a retrying fetch helper and tests for recovery, exhaustion and attempt limits. It also proposes increasing the documented cap to ten and adds a text fixture.

## Critical
- app/net.py:13 — correctness — Restore the five-attempt retry cap — When the upstream remains unavailable, a default call makes ten attempts, violating AGENTS.md:5: “Retry helpers under app/ must cap attempts at 5.” The validation also accepts explicit limits above five. — During an upstream outage, each default call doubles the permitted request load and delays failure reporting.
